devices.name: HONEYCOMB FOXTROT TAKEOFF KIT — LINKED MODE

referenceNotes: Original Alpha and Alpha XPC in PC switch mode have the same buttons and axes. The white PTT sits behind the left grip face.
The LITE uses one two-way rocker per grip. The white PTT button sits behind the left grip and the official chart illustrates it from the side.
Stock PC profile maps the left brake to X, right brake to Y and rudder travel to Z.
The official PC profile maps throttle Z, propeller Y and mixture X.
Six lever slots with interchangeable general-aviation and commercial handles. Handle buttons and reversers depend on the fitted levers.
The official GA and airliner profiles identify the four axes and mapped buttons. Go-around and reverse presses depend on fitted handles.

The original Echo chart documents the 25 numbered PC inputs. Echo XPC has the corresponding control positions with Xbox legends. Pair explicitly and verify the reported inputs for your USB, wireless, or XPC mode.
Set up the stick as a direct USB device to use this template. The OEM chart does not label the index trigger report. Use Input Learn for that control.
This template uses the Throttle Box direct USB report numbers. The engine switches report the on positions only.
Connect the Throttle Box to the stick using its linked port. Windows sees one device with independent axis reports and kit button numbers. Use the individual templates when connected separately.
